name: Heiwado Co.,Ltd.
summary: Heiwado Co.,Ltd. engages in the retailing of food, clothing, housing-related, and daily necessities products. The company operates through the Retail Business, Retail-Related Business, and Other segments. It operates various stores in Shiga, Fukui, Ishikawa, Toyama, Kyoto, Osaka, Hyogo, Gifu, and Aichi. The company also operates and manages business infrastructure facilities, as well as provides building maintenance services. In addition, it engages in the domestic retail trade; general merchandise and department store business; food manufacturing and processing; sale and rental of books, CDs, and DVDs; restaurant; and fitness and staffing business.
